description: This file defines the interface 'FieldStorageDefinitionInterface' for entity field storage definitions in Drupal, including constants, method signatures for retrieving field properties, settings, schema, constraints, and metadata.

classes.name: FieldStorageDefinitionInterface
classes.description: An interface for defining entity field storage, including methods for retrieving storage properties, settings, schema, constraints, and metadata.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the machine name of the field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the field type identifier.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns all storage settings as an array.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific storage setting.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Indicates if the field supports translation.

methods.name: setTranslatable
methods.description: Sets whether the field supports translation.

methods.name: isRevisionable
methods.description: Indicates if the field storage is revisionable.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label for the field.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the field.

methods.name: getOptionsProvider
methods.description: Provides options for a field property.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Indicates if the field can contain multiple items.

methods.name: getCardinality
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items allowed.

methods.name: getPropertyDefinition
methods.description: Gets the definition of a specific property.

methods.name: getPropertyDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all property definitions.

methods.name: getPropertyNames
methods.description: Returns the list of subproperty names.

methods.name: getMainPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the main property name, if any.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID the field is attached to.

methods.name: getSchema
methods.description: Returns the field schema array.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the field columns as defined in the schema.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Returns a specific validation constraint.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider/module name.

methods.name: hasCustomStorage
methods.description: Indicates if storage is handled separately.

methods.name: isBaseField
methods.description: Checks if the field is a base (non-configurable) field.

methods.name: getUniqueStorageIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the storage.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates if the field is marked as deleted.
